topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: Rain's been comin' down like it ain't never gonna stop, kind of like my thoughts. Got a call, you know. Old number, haven't heard from it in years. Childhood. That word's got more weight than it used to. My best friend, they said. Memories flashed, the good kind, the kind you hang onto. Met for coffee, small talk, but something was off. They didn't remember. Just…blank. I played it cool, laughed it off. Told myself it’s not that big a deal. But the way they looked at me, like a stranger. It’s the kind of thing that sticks with you, like the echo of a gunshot in an empty alley. Keeps you up at night.
